# netskope Provider

Netskope Terraform Provider: Combined specification to produce netskope terraform provider via speakeasy

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netskope = {
      source  = "netskopeoss/netskope"
      version = "0.4.13"
    }
  }
}

provider "netskope" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional - can use NETSKOPE_SERVER_URL environment variable
  tenant     = "..." # Optional
}
```

## Rate Limits and Retries

The Netskope APIs return `429` when a rate limit is exceeded. The provider does not throttle requests on the client side; it retries `429` and transient `5xx` responses with exponential backoff and jitter, honouring `Retry-After` (capped at 60 s per wait). Retries stop after `retry_max_elapsed_time` (300 s by default). Use `retry_max_elapsed_time` and `retry_disabled` (see the schema below) to tune this, for example `retry_max_elapsed_time = 30` to fail fast in CI.

### NPA private apps

Reads of NPA private apps are limited per tenant as follows. Writes and all other routes are unchanged.

| Endpoint | Per-second | Per-hour |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /apps/private` | 10 | 5,000 |
| `GET /apps/private/{id}` | 10 | 5,000 |

Every plan or refresh reads each managed `netskope_npa_private_app` and each `netskope_npa_private_app` data source with one `GET /apps/private/{id}`, and each `netskope_npa_private_apps_list` data source with one `GET /apps/private`. For large configurations the hourly limit is the relevant constraint. Backoff handles the per-second limit; if the hourly limit is exhausted the run fails with a `429` error once `retry_max_elapsed_time` is reached, and increasing it does not help. Wait for the limit to reset or reduce the number of reads (for example with `-refresh=false` or `-target`). The limits apply per tenant, so workspaces and CI jobs sharing a tenant share the budget.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key. Configurable via environment variable `NETSKOPE_API_KEY`.
- `retry_disabled` (Boolean) Disable automatic retries on rate-limited (429) or transient (5xx) errors. Default is false. When true, the provider returns the error immediately. Configurable via environment variable NETSKOPE_RETRY_DISABLED.
- `retry_max_elapsed_time` (Number) Maximum total time in seconds to spend retrying rate-limited (429) or transient (5xx) API calls before giving up. Default is 300 (5 minutes). Set to a lower value (e.g. 30) in CI pipelines to fail fast. Configurable via environment variable NETSKOPE_RETRY_MAX_ELAPSED.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://{tenant}.goskope.com/api/v2)
- `tenant` (String) Netskope tenant name (e.g. "acme" for acme.goskope.com)
